operator_program_identity.geometry_identity: sha256 digest of grid.null, wall.null, sample.null, area, cell_average_stencil, cell_average_weight, inside_material, moment_geometry, polarity, use_linear_moments, wall_unit_offsets, wall_unit_closed, wall_unit_kinds and the specialised operator state (forward_operator.py:2133 _compute_geometry_identity)
operator_program_identity.reading: the operator identity is VALUE-keyed, so two identities whose meshes differ in values but not in shapes still receive different program keys and cannot share a compiled program unless the identity itself is bucketed

static_lengths.coordinates_cells: tuple(np.asarray(coordinates.cells, dtype=np.intp)) is hashed whole, so the LENGTH of the support cell index list is a static shape of the program; reduced_coordinates derives it host-side from np.flatnonzero(profile_participation), so it is a static length, not a traced dimension
static_lengths.argument_layouts: _compiled_argument_layout(value) returns (shape, dtype) and _compiled_argument_key(value) adds a value digest for the arrays a program captures

separate_aggregates.entry_key: reduced_newton.py:2076 _compiled_entry_key omits conductor currents deliberately, so a same-shaped prescribed-current edit re-enters the built program (exterior flux is a traced argument)
separate_aggregates.cache: reduced_newton.py:246 _compiled_program_cache, an OrderedDict bounded by _COMPILED_PROGRAM_CACHE_LIMIT, remembered by _remember_compiled_program (reduced_newton.py:2137)

addressable_axes: support cell capacity (the length of coordinates.cells)
augmentation row count and row signature

persistent_cache_pruner.identity: JAX's own persistent-cache LRU, not a nova or systemd unit
persistent_cache_pruner.rule: on every put, while the summed size of the entry files exceeds (max_size - additional_size), pop the entry whose '<key>-atime' sidecar (an int stored little-endian) is smallest, then unlink both the entry file and its -atime sidecar; eviction is skipped entirely when eviction_enabled is false (jax/_src/lru_cache.py:170-210)
persistent_cache_pruner.sidecar: each entry is accompanied by a '<key>-atime' file holding the access stamp that orders eviction

no_external_timer.crontab: crontab -l reported no crontab for mcintos
no_external_timer.systemd_user_timers: systemctl --user list-timers --all lists only systemd-tmpfiles-clean.timer, imas-codex-graph-push.timer and grub-boot-success.timer, none of which touches the compilation cache path
no_external_timer.tmpfiles_rules: no rule in /usr/lib/tmpfiles.d or /etc/tmpfiles.d names nova or the compilation cache, and no ~/.config/user-tmpfiles.d exists
no_external_timer.consequence: entries leave the cache only through LRUCache._evict under the 8 GiB bound (or an explicit reset), so a shared pre-warmed cache location must either raise that bound or keep entries warm
